subject.title: fix(build): fall back to tsx for build TypeScript scripts

question: Should OpenClaw land this build-all-only `tsx` fallback now, or require broader package-script coverage before merge?
rationale: The patch is a focused and apparently correct fix for `pnpm build`, but accepting the intentionally narrower build-all scope is a maintainer merge judgment.

options.title: Land the build-all fallback
options.body: Merge the narrow fix for the reported `pnpm build` path and handle direct package-script compatibility only if maintainers want that broader guarantee.

options.title: Broaden before merge
options.body: Ask for the same no-native-TypeScript fallback to cover direct package scripts before this PR lands.

options.title: Pause or close
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers do not want to support source-checkout builds on Node binaries without native TypeScript stripping.

recommendation.title: Land the build-all fallback
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow fix for the reported `pnpm build` path and handle direct package-script compatibility only if maintainers want that broader guarantee.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is already assigned to vincentkoc and this handle has recent build-all/script history in the affected area.
